title: Capital requirements.
bodyText: A title insurer shall have a minimum capital, which shall be paid in and maintained, of not less than $400,000.
history: [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2 as superseded by c 348, §21]
bodyHtml: §431:20-107  Capital requirements.  A title insurer shall have a minimum capital, which shall be paid in and maintained, of not less than $400,000. [L 1987, c 347, pt of §2 as superseded by c 348, §21]
